reading.title: The Word Part Re
reading.purpose: Learn how the word part re changes a word.
paras: The word part re means again. If you redo your work, you do it again. You can reread a book and retell the story. You can rewrite a sentence to make it better.
If a tower falls, rebuild it. We reuse jars and refill them. We recycle paper to make new paper.

qs.why: The word part re means again, so redo means do it again.

qs.q: What can you do to read a book one more time?
qs.why: You reread a book to read it again.

qs.q: What can we do with old paper?
qs.why: The reading says we recycle paper to make new paper.
